name: Attachment Optimizer
description: Pre-extracts embedded subtitles, batches attachment extraction, deduplicates identical files, and safely manages plugin-owned cache data.
overview: Subtitle pre-extraction and optimized attachment caching for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog:
- Add separate library-scan extraction for embedded subtitles and attachments.
- Add manual subtitle and attachment extraction tasks under the Attachment Optimizer category.
- Add independent library filters and optional subtitle codec limits.
- Store scheduled attachment extraction directly in the deduplicated optimizer cache.
- Redesign the settings page for clearer extractor and optimizer controls.

- Prevents empty per-media attachment directories during ordinary attachment delivery.
- Removes stale empty GUID attachment directories during cache cleanup.
- Preserves active, non-empty, and unrelated directories.

Jellyfin 12.0-compatible release.

- Extracts missing attachments in one FFmpeg batch.
- Deduplicates identical content with SHA-256 and hard links.
- Preserves detected font file formats.
- Provides opt-in cleanup for plugin-managed cache data.

The ZIP contains the plugin DLL and complete meta.json metadata.

name: Subtitle Font Bridge
description: Supplies compatible Jellyfin Web builds with matching server OS fonts and fonts cached by Attachment Optimizer.
overview: Resolve ASS/SSA font families from server and optimized cached fonts.

versions.changelog:
- Add settings for server OS fonts and Attachment Optimizer cached fonts, both enabled by default.
- Detect Attachment Optimizer availability and expose active font-source status.
- Watch enabled font directories and refresh the multilingual OpenType alias index automatically.
- Add a dedicated plugin configuration page and source-selection tests.

- Logs requested, missing, and returned ASS/SSA font files for diagnosis.
- Supports automatic embedded-font retry in the matching customized Jellyfin Web release.
- Keeps multilingual OpenType family alias resolution.

Jellyfin 12.0-compatible release for the customized Jellyfin Web build.

- Resolves exact ASS/SSA font families from server-installed fonts.
- Indexes multilingual OpenType family aliases from name IDs 1 and 16.
- Applies normalized alias matching for reliable font lookup.

The ZIP contains the plugin DLL and complete meta.json metadata.
